page: OVHcloud r3-64 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz without hyperthreading. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is provided by a 200 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate strong memory write performance, with a large block write speed of 101.05 GB/sec and a high PassMark memory score of 2964.73. Single-core CPU performance is also strong, as demonstrated by a stress-ng single-core score of 3078.58. Multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, and database operations fall within the average range. In text processing and text generation for small language models, the server exhibits strong capabilities, while medium-sized model inference and static web serving throughput remain average.

The r3-64 offers a resource-dense profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of hyperthreading, ensuring dedicated execution resources per vCPU. While its single-core performance and memory write speeds are strong, its multi-core scaling and read bandwidth are moderate. This makes it a cost-efficient choice for workloads that require high memory capacity relative to compute power, such as in-memory databases, caching layers, text processing pipelines, and lightweight language model inference, rather than highly parallelized compute-heavy tasks.
